predictions.text: I predict that the first round of the election to the Senate, the upper house of the Parliament of the Czech Republic, results in a close race with no clear winner, but the winning party is likely to be the ANO 2011.
I predict that the Gaza war will continue with more airstrikes and clashes, resulting in at least 4,000 Palestinians killed in Gaza by the end of Saturday, 17 October 2026.
I predict that Georgia reports the highest number of damages and multiple counties are declared disaster areas in total across affected states.

I predict that Russian forces will launch another ballistic missile and drone attack on civilian targets in Ukraine, killing at least 28 people and wounding hundreds, with the attacks targeting areas in the eastern regions of Ukraine.

I predict that the identity of the suspect in the 15-year-old student who carried out the mass stabbing at a primary school in Leszczydół-Nowiny, Wyszków County, Poland will be revealed by the end of Saturday, 17 October 2026.
I predict that there will be another prison riot in Sinaloa state prisons, resulting in more injuries than the previous incident.
I predict that the Government of Guinea-Bissau will announce the new election date as December 11, 2026, and that this decision will be met with mixed reactions from various political parties.
I predict that the number of protests in major cities increases, particularly in New York City, United States, involving clashes between protestors and police.

I predict that South Korea will issue another statement expressing dissatisfaction with Ukraine's handling of the North Korean soldiers' case, likely focusing on the breach of the non-disclosure agreement.
